title: 生物信息分析设计
scope: Omics analysis planning, biological replication, reference compatibility, batch confounding and reproducibility.
routingDescription: Omics analysis planning, biological replication, reference compatibility, batch confounding and reproducibility.
useWhen: Review RNA-seq or other omics analysis plans
Interpret findings affected by sample or reference design

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use statistical inference for non-domain-specific estimands and uncertainty.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify the measurement layer, organism, scientific contrast and biological sample unit.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Choose assay-appropriate methods rather than a generic omics recipe.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When samples include technical or cell-level repeats
diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate biological and technical replication and identify condition-batch confounding.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Avoid claiming independent biological evidence from technical repeats or cells.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When datasets or annotations are combined
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check genome assembly, annotation release, coordinate convention and identifier mapping. A missing reference version is unknown, not proof of a mismatch.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Resolve reference mismatches before interpreting missing genes or peaks.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When transformed or batch-corrected data are analyzed
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check the input expected by the statistical method and design-matrix identifiability.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Do not recommend correcting away a fully confounded effect or using incompatible inputs.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When differential or enrichment findings are claimed
diagnosticChecklist.check: Require effect sizes, multiplicity handling, appropriate background and reproducible provenance.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Describe research evidence limits and separate association from mechanism.

evidenceRequirements: Assay and sample metadata with condition and batch
Transformation steps and the planned statistical contrast
qualityChecks: No disease diagnosis from exploratory omics findings
Reference and biological replicate assumptions are explicit
Pathway interpretation reflects background and multiplicity
Keep unrecorded metadata distinct from a demonstrated incompatibility
riskRules: Research consultation does not establish clinical validity; identifiable participant data require authorized handling

preferredSources: Reference assembly and annotation release documentation
Assay-specific analysis-method documentation and supplied sample provenance
refreshTriggers: Current reference releases and version-specific method guidance
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: All cases were processed in batch A and all controls in batch B.
examples.expected: Recognize complete confounding and explain what the design cannot identify.
examples.reject: Claim batch correction can recover the disease effect without additional evidence.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
Tightened evidence and recommendation boundaries after the first synthetic live case review; broad professional validation remains pending.
